# arin_rpki_publication (Data Source)

Read an RFC 8181 publication inventory using an existing BPKI signing identity. Sends a signed list request and verifies the response against the configured peer anchor. Does not publish or remove objects, enroll accounts, or use ARIN_API_KEY. Updates local exchange journals; interrupted or unverifiable exchanges remain pending and block automatic retry. No native ARIN delegated sandbox verification is available yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Requires an existing delegated publication identity and enrollment.
# Keep the key file and persistent journal directory private.
data "arin_rpki_publication" "example" {
  endpoint                = "https://publication.example.net/service/publisher"
  publisher_handle        = "publisher"
  journal_directory       = pathexpand("~/.local/state/arin-rpki")
  signing_key_file        = pathexpand("~/.config/arin-rpki/signing-key.pem")
  signing_certificate_pem = file("signing-ee.pem")
  signing_ca_pem          = file("local-ca.pem")
  signing_crls_pem        = file("local-crls.pem")
  peer_ca_pem             = file("repository-ca.pem")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Publication service URL from a trusted repository response. Requires HTTPS, except HTTP on loopback for tests.
- `journal_directory` (String) Absolute path to an existing private directory for durable signing-time and pending-request journals. Must persist between runs. Failed exchanges can require recovery before further reads.
- `peer_ca_pem` (String) Explicit publication server BPKI trust anchor established out of band, in PEM format.
- `publisher_handle` (String) Assigned publisher handle. Scopes the durable exchange journal; publication authorization is determined by the BPKI identity and endpoint.
- `signing_ca_pem` (String) Explicit local BPKI trust anchor in PEM format.
- `signing_certificate_pem` (String) Existing BPKI signing EE certificate in PEM format.
- `signing_crls_pem` (String) Concatenated current PEM CRLs for the local BPKI signing chain.
- `signing_key_file` (String) Local private RSA key file, PKCS#8 or PKCS#1 PEM, with no group or other permissions. Symlinks are rejected. Only the path is retained in Terraform state; key bytes are never returned.

### Optional

- `peer_intermediates_pem` (String) Concatenated publication server BPKI intermediate CA certificates, if needed.
- `signing_intermediates_pem` (String) Concatenated local BPKI intermediate CA certificates, if needed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable SHA-256 identity of the protocol, endpoint, publisher and BPKI anchors.
- `objects` (Attributes List) Published objects sorted by URI. These server-reported hashes do not independently validate RPKI resource objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--objects))

<a id="nestedatt--objects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `objects`

Read-Only:

- `sha256` (String) Server-reported lowercase SHA-256 object hash.
- `uri` (String) Published rsync object URI.
